name: Benign Deny + empty NotAction complement (must NOT be flagged)
note: IAM-1508 no-over-fire control. A Deny with an empty NotAction complement denies EVERYTHING (an empty complement excludes nothing); it grants nothing and is benign. Only an Allow can MASK a grant, so this must never be flagged as a masked grant. Pins the Effect:'Allow' scoping of the empty-complement detection.
